title: 第78章 来点反特题材，大家都爱看

第78章 来点反特题材，大家都爱看-《文豪1978：从军旅作家开始》

“刚写了一部小说，不过被首长拿去了。我想问问，咱们现在八一厂有没有什么偏好？”刘济民算了算，自己手头也没啥钱了，想要挣钱，还得写起来。
要不然亲个嘴都没地儿，关键时候跑出来个糟老头子喊“停”，这您受得了吗？
另外在外面，终究是有点风险。
“偏好嘛。我们自然想创作出深受群众喜欢的作品，你能写反特题材的吗？现在群众们对这种隐秘的事情，特别喜欢。以前是喊着防特反特，现在大家都跑到电影院里看反特电影儿。你要是能写出来这种剧本，我拼了老命也要向厂里推荐
王愿坚说到反特题材，脸上的褶子都抚平了，精神抖擞。他知道这题材好，但八一厂拍的并没有北影厂好。
不仅没有北影厂拍得好，还没有长影厂拍得好，数量更没他们多。
“反特啊，我行！”刘济民拍着胸脯说道。
“真的行！”
“真的行。卖冰棍的老太太都能拍成特务，别的不说，就说我家胡同口那负责电话的大妈。”
“她是特务？”
“哎呦喂，您想哪儿去了，要是特务，她不早就变成我胸口的挂件了！”
“怎么说？”
“军功章啊！”
“可惜！”王愿坚也不知道在惋惜啥。
菊儿胡同口，负责电话的黄大妈，忽然感觉到一阵阴风吹来，毛骨悚然，浑身不适。
王愿坚让刘济民大胆创作，越大胆越好，最好能把北影厂、长影厂统统给干趴下。
“我们好歹是军队的电影厂，拍的不如他们，我出去都没面子。”王愿坚说起这话来，咬牙切齿，又有点酸溜溜的，“你需要什么资料的话，尽管来找我。我告诉你，在战史资料方面，我就是活字典。”
王愿坚最后这句话倒是没吹牛，采访过一百多位战将，还有九位战帅。
“得嘞，您歇着，我心里有数，有需要来找您！”刘济民笑着说道。
王愿坚将刘济民送出办公室，感慨道：“我这一辈子还没获过一等功呢，也不知道还有没有机会！”
刘济民算是明白了，刚才说的“可惜”是什么意思，感情是想抓特务立功呢！
“济民，有好本子一定要拿来给我看看。”
“放心吧您，我一准儿拿过来给您看！”
走出八一厂大楼，刘济民回学校的路上，凑巧路过燕影厂大楼，出于维护客情关系的想法，去看望了一下亲爱的于大姐。

"I just wrote a novel, but it was taken away by the chief. I would like to ask, do we have any preferences at Bayi Factory now?" Liu Jimin figured it out. He didn't have any money at all. If he wanted to make money, he had to start writing.
Otherwise, there will be no room for kissing, and at the critical moment, a bad old man will come out and shout "stop". Can you bear this?
Besides, being outside is a bit risky after all.
"It's about preference. We naturally want to create works that are popular with the masses. Can you write about anti-special themes? Nowadays, the masses are very fond of such secretive things. In the past, they shouted to prevent special agents and oppose special agents, but now everyone goes to the cinema to watch anti-special agents movies. If you can write this kind of script, I will risk my life to recommend it to the factory
When Wang Yuanjian talked about anti-special themes, the wrinkles on his face smoothed out and he became energetic. He knew that the subject matter was good, but the films produced by Bayi Film Studio were not as good as those produced by Beijing Film Studio.
Not only are they not as good as Beijing Film Studio, they are also not as good as Changying Film Studio, and the quantity is not as large as theirs.
"Reverse, I can do it! Liu Jimin said, patting his chest.
"It really works! "
"It really works. The old lady selling popsicles can be photographed as a spy. Among other things, let’s just talk about the aunt in charge of the phone at the entrance of my alley. "
"She's a spy? "
"Hey, what are you thinking about? If she were a spy, she would have become a pendant on my chest! "
"How to say? "
"Military medal! "
"pity! "Wang Yuanjian didn't know what he was regretting.
At the entrance of Ju'er Alley, Aunt Huang, who was in charge of the telephone, suddenly felt a gust of cold wind blowing, making her hair stand on end and feeling uncomfortable all over her body.
Wang Yuanjian asked Liu Jimin to create boldly. The bolder the better. It would be best if he could bring down both Beijing Film Studio and Changying Film Studio.
"We are a military film studio after all, and our productions are not as good as theirs. I don't even have the dignity to go out. " Wang Yuanjian gritted his teeth when he said this, and was a little sour. "If you need any information, just come to me. Let me tell you, I am a walking dictionary when it comes to war history materials. "
Wang Yuanjian's last words were not bragging. He had interviewed more than a hundred generals and nine war commanders.
"Okay, just rest, I know what's going on and I'll come to you if I need it! Liu Jimin said with a smile.
Wang Yuanjian sent Liu Jimin out of the office and said with emotion: "I have never received first-class merit in my life, and I don't know if I will have a chance! "
Liu Jimin finally understood what he meant by "what a pity" just now. His feelings were that he wanted to catch the spy and perform meritorious service!
“Jimin, if you have a good book, be sure to show it to me. "
"Don't worry, I'll bring it to you right away! "
After walking out of the Bayi Factory Building, Liu Jimin happened to pass by the Yanying Factory Building on his way back to school. Out of the idea of maintaining customer relations, he went to visit his dear Sister Yu.
